title: R3: the fixed rule on net1 v3 with a retrained capacity head, on validation links
description: Whether retraining only net1 v3's capacity head repairs the fixed rule (window = 2^u times net1's believed BDP) where net1 v3 lost to BBRv3, a Cubic flow from the start. The rule on the two repaired net1s of r3-capacity-head.json (v3head: capacity's bins refitted; v3headkeep: net1 v3's bins kept), next to the rule on net1 v3 (model-net1v3), on net1 v4 (the run chosen in exp-net1v4-grid-10) and on the true BDP (oracle, in net1 v3's bins), each for u in {0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.375, 0.5}, with BBRv3 as the reference, on the validation links: the training conditions at 20 s and 60 s, and the new, deep-long and cubic-first families (experiments/heldout.py), campaign seed 11, as exp-rule-net1v4-val-69. Each group's u is the one with the best mean difference from BBRv3 over the five campaigns (chosen.json); the test links are not touched. The r3 input names the release of r3-capacity-head.json: replace NN with its run number before running this.
prepare: U="0 0.125 0.25 0.375 0.5"; N=("v3head=$IN/r3/refit/net1.pt" "v3headkeep=$IN/r3/keep/net1.pt" "v3=$IN/models/net1v3.pt" "v4=$IN/grid/$(cat "$IN/grid/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"); for x in "${N[@]}"; do uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/${x%%=*}" "${x#*=}" --u $U; done; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/oracle" "$IN/models/net1v3.pt" --u $U --oracle; P=(); for u in $U; do for x in "${N[@]}"; do P+=(--policy "${x%%=*}-u$u=$OUT/${x%%=*}/rule-u$u.onnx"); done; P+=(--policy "oracle-u$u=$OUT/oracle/rule-u$u-oracle.onnx"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 11 11 bbr3 "${P[@]}"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --select v3head v3headkeep v3 v4 oracle
